purpose: Constrain Task71 discovery to a predeclared, bounded search before any new family outcome is computed -- prevents an unconstrained hunt for whatever looks profitable and bounds multiple-testing exposure by construction.

families.name: AVWAP_FLOW_STATE
families.hypothesis: Price behavior relative to a causally-computed session-anchored VWAP differentiates continuation from exhaustion/reversion.
families.decision_time_rationale: ~90 minutes of causal AVWAP formation after 09:30 ET open -- enough for the anchor to be economically meaningful, still well before the 13:30 dynamic-cutoff ceiling for a 120m/180m horizon capped at 15:50 ET flatten.
families.threshold_unit: vol-normalized distance from session AVWAP (distance / trailing-20-bar realized volatility of 1m returns, in units of that volatility)
families.not_hardcoded: No single sigma value is treated as THE threshold -- both bands are evaluated and a response surface (not a single point) is reported.

families.name: OVERNIGHT_GAP_CONTINUATION
families.honest_naming_note: NOT called PEAD -- see event_data_audit.json Part 17. This repo has no verified, causal, timestamped historical earnings-surprise dataset; using 'PEAD' would imply event attribution this data cannot support.
families.hypothesis: An overnight gap (session close -> next session open, using premarket data where available) persists/continues into the regular session, independent of the specific catalyst.
families.horizon_note: next-day/3-day horizons are MULTI_DAY -- reported and diagnosed completely separately from intraday statistics, per Part 8/19.

families.name: IDIOSYNCRATIC_RESIDUAL_MOMENTUM
families.hypothesis: Stock-specific residual movement beyond market-model-implied movement (R_stock - beta*R_SPY) persists over subsequent minutes/hours.
families.beta_estimation: Trailing 20-trading-day daily-close-to-close OLS beta vs SPY, estimated using ONLY data strictly before the trading day being evaluated -- recomputed once per (symbol, day), never using same-day or future data.
families.residual_measurement_window: 09:30-11:00 ET same-day residual (stock's actual 09:30->11:00 return minus beta * SPY's 09:30->11:00 return)

families.name: FAILED_STRUCTURAL_BREAK
families.honest_naming_note: Called FAILED_STRUCTURAL_BREAK, not 'liquidity trap' -- no order-book/liquidity mechanics data exists to support that label.
families.hypothesis: A failed penetration of a meaningful prior structural level (prior-day high/low) produces a reversal.

fifth_family_note: The forensic audit (Part 1) did not surface a materially new structural opportunity beyond A-D that isn't already a variant of one of them -- no fifth family is declared. This decision is made HERE, before any Family A-D outcome is computed, per Part 6's own requirement not to add families after seeing weak results.
long_short_separation: MANDATORY, no pooling anywhere in this task -- see Part 10.

development_datasets.policy: Broaden DEVELOPMENT using already-contaminated historical periods (2025-01-24..2026-08-14) only -- see development_universe_audit.json for the exact slices selected and their provenance. The remaining clean 2024 territory is NEVER touched in Task71.
development_datasets.existing_slice_reused: data/historical_1m/task67a_development/ (2026-05-15..2026-08-14, 35 symbols, already on disk, F6's own original DEVELOPMENT window)
development_datasets.new_slices_to_materialize: see development_data_manifest.json for exact dates -- selected for calendar/regime diversity across the already-contaminated 2025-01-24..2026-08-14 range, NOT for their content (no outcome is computed before slice selection).

stability_tests: time_stability: early/middle/late (and any materially distinct regime slice) segments per Part 15 -- sign consistency preferred over magnitude
parameter_stability: response surface across both predeclared threshold bands per family -- prefer broad same-sign plateau, downrank an isolated single-band winner

dependence_diagnostics: cluster-by-symbol AND cluster-by-day bootstrap CIs (research_stats.bootstrap_ci_clustered) for every promising cell -- report the WEAKER interpretation if they materially differ
concentration_diagnostics: top1/top3 symbol and day contribution (research_stats.concentration_metrics) for every promising cell
regime_conditioning: SPY-direction/SPY-realized-vol context reported as a DEVELOPMENT response-surface variable, never as a post-hoc rescue filter
nomination_criteria_ref: See Part 21 of the task instructions -- reproduced verbatim in candidate_ranking.md's own header. All 15 conditions apply; none are loosened here or later.

complexity_penalty.method: For every family/direction combination surviving to candidate_ranking.csv, record number_of_required_conditions, number_of_tuned_numeric_parameters, number_of_data_sources. A combination requiring materially more conditions/parameters/sources than a comparable alternative is downranked, not automatically rejected.

number_of_family_parameter_hypotheses_pr.FAMILY_A: 4 directions x 2 threshold bands x 3 horizons (30/60/120m) = 24 cells
number_of_family_parameter_hypotheses_pr.FAMILY_B: 2 directions x 2 gap-threshold bands x 5 horizons (120m/180m/EOD/next-day/3-day) = 20 cells
number_of_family_parameter_hypotheses_pr.FAMILY_C: 2 directions x 2 threshold bands x 4 horizons (60/120/180m/EOD) = 16 cells
number_of_family_parameter_hypotheses_pr.FAMILY_D: 2 directions x 2 reclaim-window bands x 3 horizons (30/60/120m) = 12 cells
number_of_family_parameter_hypotheses_pr.note: This is the full predeclared grid size for the multiple-testing count in multiple_testing_summary.json -- every cell that is actually computed is counted, whether or not it looks promising. No cell is silently dropped from the count after seeing its result.

candidate_count_limit: AT MOST ONE primary candidate (PRIMARY_CANDIDATE_READY_TO_FREEZE) may be produced. AT MOST ONE additional RESEARCH_LEAD_ONLY may be recorded. No third candidate of any kind is prepared for holdout testing.

holdout_protection_rule.rule: Task70's consumed 2024 blocks (2024-02-01..2024-03-15, 2024-09-03..2024-10-18) and ALL remaining clean 2024 territory are NEVER accessed, downloaded, or outcome-computed in Task71. Only an inventory of remaining candidate future holdout periods is produced (see task71_summary.md) -- no outcome is ever computed against them.
holdout_protection_rule.enforcement: research/task71_lib/holdout_guard.py -- a DevelopmentOnlyGuard raising immediately if any 2024 date is requested by Task71 code, tested in tests/test_task71_holdout_guard.py.
